figures.finding: A guest director staging a play at a theatre of the Estonian Association of Performing Arts Institutions (EETEAL) is paid at least a multiple of the group's minimum salary under the general terms agreed with the directors' and dramaturgs' union (ELDL) on 18 December 2024, for an indefinite term; the union prices the multiples for 2026 at EUR 7,740 gross (4.5 times: a full-scale production at a state or state-funded theatre), EUR 6,192 (3.6 times: the same by a starting director, with fewer than four such productions) and EUR 4,300 (2.5 times: a private or unfunded municipal theatre).

value.agreement: ELDL-EETEAL general terms of a theatre-director contract, 2024

figures.applies: Estonia, guest directors of ELDL engaged by EETEAL member theatres, from the start of 2026, the year the union's figures are for. A small-scale staging at a state-funded theatre (3 times) has no euro figure in the union's helper and isn't held; a special project's fee is negotiated.
